summary: Core AI Holdings filed a Form 6-K reporting the departure of CFO Gerald Bernstein effective June 30, 2026, and the appointment of Arie Goor as new CFO effective July 1, 2026. Mr. Goor serves through an agreement with Shimony Financial Services at $9,000 per month, subject to 30-day termination notice. The change is abrupt but the press release frames it as a routine strengthening. This is a non-U.S. filer (British Columbia) reporting via Form 6-K. Watch for any subsequent operational or strategic shifts tied to the new CFO.
